description_en: Grants special travel permissions to enterprise employees
description_zh: 调用本接口，可实现为企业员工授予特殊差旅权限
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen isv-rule-save --user-id user_1234 --book-type authorizedPerson --status 1 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IsvRuleSave

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access credential.
When you call the operation over HTTP, you must append this parameter as a required parameter to the request URL. For information about how to obtain the credential, see Enterprise access credential (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When you append the parameter, you can use `crop_token=value` instead
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
通过 HTTP 方式进行接口调用时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，可以使用`crop_token=value`替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

parameters.help_en: The type of role permission granted to the employee
parameters.help_zh: 为员工授予的角色权限类型
parameters.name: book_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the authorization takes effect
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en:
The ID of the employee who can be booked for.
You can specify the IDs of up to 300 employees.
If the number of employees exceeds 300, you can set `entitp_type` to `4` and pass values by department
fields.help_zh:
可被代订人员 ID。
最多传入300位员工的 ID。
若人数超出 300 的限制，可以使 `entitp_type=4` ，按部门维度传值
fields.name: entity_id

fields.help_en:
The effective scope of the booking permission.
This parameter takes effect only when `book_type` is set to `bookPerson`.
If this parameter is not specified, the permission takes effect for all employees by default
fields.help_zh:
代订权限生效范围。
仅 `book_type = bookPerson` 时生效。
本范围不设置默认为全员生效
fields.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: The list of effective scopes for the booking agent permission
parameters.help_zh: 代订人权限生效范围列表
parameters.name: bookuser_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the current employee needs to submit a travel approval form when making a booking
parameters.help_zh: 当前人员预订是否需要提交出差审批单
parameters.name: apply_need

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the current employee's booking is subject to travel standards
parameters.help_zh: 当前人员预订是否受差标影响
parameters.name: rule_need
